# Tintboard

> Tintboard is two Atlassian Marketplace apps for Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud, free for up to 10 users, made in France. Tintboard for Jira lets an admin choose label, status, column, swimlane and card colours (on company- and team-managed boards), show extra fields on cards and narrow the issue view's details panel. Tintboard for Confluence sets font size, line spacing and reading width, code block themes and page styles without custom CSS, for the site or each space, and each reader can adjust them.

How it works: an admin sets everything once in the app's settings page in Jira or Confluence; the free Tintboard browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) applies it in each person's browser, because Marketplace apps can't restyle Jira's and Confluence's own pages. The extension talks only to the person's own Atlassian site.

- [Tintboard for Jira](https://tintboard.com/jira/): what the Jira app does, with screenshots
- [Tintboard for Confluence](https://tintboard.com/confluence/): what the Confluence app does, with screenshots
- [Tintboard for Jira on the Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2391653742/tintboard-label-status-and-card-colors-for-jira)
- [Tintboard for Confluence on the Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/3987520951/tintboard-font-size-and-reading-width-for-confluence)
- [Getting started](https://tintboard.com/docs/getting-started/)

## Guides

- [Jira Label Colors: How to Choose Them in Jira Cloud](https://tintboard.com/guides/label-colours/): Jira Cloud picks label colors at random. How to choose the color of each Jira label (blocked in red, customer in purple) for the whole team, on every board.
- [Jira Status Colors: How to Change Them in Jira Cloud](https://tintboard.com/guides/status-colours/): Jira gives statuses only gray, blue or green. How to give each Jira status its own color without changing its category or your reports.
- [Confluence Font Size: How to Change It in Confluence Cloud](https://tintboard.com/guides/confluence-font-size/): Confluence Cloud has no font size setting. How to change the default text size, line spacing and reading width for the whole site, a space or each reader.
- [Confluence Line Spacing: How to Change It in Cloud](https://tintboard.com/guides/confluence-line-spacing/): Confluence Cloud has no line or paragraph spacing setting. What works natively (Shift+Enter, page width) and how to set line spacing per site or space.
- [Jira Card Colors: Color Cards by Rule, Even Team-Managed](https://tintboard.com/guides/card-colours/): Color Jira cards by label, priority, assignee or due date, on company- and team-managed boards: what Jira card colors can do, and a full-card tint.
- [Jira Board Color Schemes: 5 Ready-Made Sets (Free)](https://tintboard.com/guides/jira-colour-schemes/): Five ready-made Jira board color schemes: label, status, column and card colors for Scrum, Kanban, support, bugs and colour-blind teams. Apply in one click.
- [Jira Column Colors and WIP Limits That Stand Out](https://tintboard.com/guides/column-colours/): Give Jira board columns their own colors and a title that turns red over the WIP limit, on company- and team-managed boards.
- [Jira Swimlane Colors: Color Each Swimlane by Title](https://tintboard.com/guides/swimlane-colours/): Jira swimlanes have no color. How to color each swimlane, by assignee, epic or query, on company- and team-managed boards.
- [Color Jira Cards by Priority (Team-Managed Boards Too)](https://tintboard.com/guides/priority-colours/): Make highest-priority Jira cards stand out: Jira card colors by priority, and full-card tints by priority on any board, team-managed included.
- [Show More Fields on Jira Cards (Team-Managed Boards)](https://tintboard.com/guides/card-fields/): Show story points, sprint, due date or any custom field on Jira board cards, including team-managed boards, without opening each issue.
- [Confluence Code Block Themes: Change the Code Theme in Cloud](https://tintboard.com/guides/code-block-themes/): Confluence Cloud has no code block theme option. Set dark or light code themes (Paper, Mint, Night, Ocean, High contrast) for every block, all WCAG AA.
- [Change the Font in Confluence Cloud (No Custom CSS)](https://tintboard.com/guides/page-styles/): Confluence Cloud has no font picker or custom CSS. Set a serif font, heading styles, underlined links and striped tables for the site or each space.
- [Widen the Jira Issue View or Hide the Details Panel](https://tintboard.com/guides/issue-view-width/): More room for the description in the Jira issue view: narrow or hide the details panel for you or your whole team, keeping the status in view.
- [Color-Blind Friendly Jira Boards: Palette and Legend](https://tintboard.com/guides/colour-blind-boards/): Make Jira boards readable for color-blind teammates: habits that help, a color-blind-safe palette (Okabe-Ito) and a legend on every board.
- [Jira Free Plan: Label, Card and Status Colors](https://tintboard.com/guides/jira-free-plan-colours/): Teams on the Jira Free plan (up to 10 users) get no card colors on team-managed boards. How to color labels, statuses and cards for free.

## Free tools

- [Confluence Font Size and Width Preview (Free Tool)](https://tintboard.com/tools/confluence-reading-preview/): Free preview of Confluence font size, line spacing and page width on a sample page, with the characters per line readers find comfortable.
- [Jira Card Color JQL Builder (Free Tool)](https://tintboard.com/tools/jira-card-colour-jql/): Free JQL builder for Jira card colors: overdue, blocked, due soon and stale cards, in the right order for Board settings, with a live preview.
- [Jira Color Checker: Color-Blind Safe Labels (Free Tool)](https://tintboard.com/tools/jira-colour-checker/): Free Jira color checker: see your label colors as color-blind teammates do, find look-alike pairs and low-contrast text, and fix them in one click.

- [Security](https://tintboard.com/security/): Tintboard is built so that there is as little as possible to protect: no Tintboard server holds or receives customer data.
- [Support](https://tintboard.com/support/): Email hello@tintboard.com. We answer within 1 business day, in English or French.

## Tintboard 日本語

- [Tintboard：Jira の色と Confluence の文字サイズ](https://tintboard.com/ja/): Jira Cloud のラベル・ステータス・カードの色と、Confluence Cloud の文字サイズ・読みやすい幅を設定。10 ユーザーまで無料。
- [Jira Cloud でラベルの色を設定する方法](https://tintboard.com/ja/guides/jira-label-colors/): 2026 年から Jira Cloud はラベルを色付きで表示しますが、色は Jira がランダムに決めます。blocked を赤に、customer を紫にすることはできず、意味がまったく違う 2 つのラベルが同じ色になることもあります。できることは次のとおりです。
- [Jira Cloud でステータスの色を変える方法](https://tintboard.com/ja/guides/jira-status-colors/): Jira は各ステータスに、ステータスカテゴリに応じて 3 色のいずれかを付けます。To Do はグレー、進行中 は青、完了 は緑です。そのため レビュー中、ブロック中、顧客待ち はたいてい同じ青になります。
- [Jira のカードの色：ルールでボードを色分け](https://tintboard.com/ja/guides/jira-card-colors/): 色付きのカードがあると、ボードを遠くからでも読み取れます。ブロック中の作業は赤、バグはストライプ、自分のカードは強調表示。Jira Cloud には標準機能がありますが、すべてのボードで使えるわけではありません。
- [色覚の多様性に配慮した Jira ボード](https://tintboard.com/ja/guides/jira-color-blind-boards/): 男性の約 12 人に 1 人、女性の約 200 人に 1 人が何らかの色覚特性を持っています。Jira ボードでは、それが「赤いカードはブロック中」と「一部のカードが少し暗い」の違いになることがあります。いくつかの習慣で、色を誰にとっても役立つものにできます。
- [Jira Free プラン：ラベル・カード・ステータスの色](https://tintboard.com/ja/guides/jira-free-colors/): Jira の Free プランは最大 10 人のチーム向けで、多くのチームがチーム管理対象プロジェクトを使っています。そこが、Jira で色の選択肢が最も少ない場所です。ラベルの色は Jira が決め、ステータスはカテゴリに従い、チーム管理対象ボードにはカードの色がありません。
- [Confluence Cloud の文字サイズを変える方法](https://tintboard.com/ja/guides/confluence-font-size/): Confluence Cloud には文字サイズの設定がありません。全員が同じ文字サイズと行間で読みます。長いページで読者が疲れる場合や、弱視やディスレクシアの読者がいる場合は、次の方法があります。

## Tintboard 中文

- [Tintboard：Jira 颜色与 Confluence 字号](https://tintboard.com/zh/): 在 Jira Cloud 中设置标签、状态和卡片颜色，在 Confluence Cloud 中设置字号和阅读宽度。最多 10 位用户免费。
- [如何在 Jira Cloud 中设置标签颜色](https://tintboard.com/zh/guides/jira-label-colors/): 自 2026 年起，Jira Cloud 会以彩色显示标签，但颜色由 Jira 随机分配。您无法把 blocked 设为红色或把 customer 设为紫色，含义完全不同的两个标签也可能是同一种颜色。下面是可行的做法。
- [如何在 Jira Cloud 中更改状态颜色](https://tintboard.com/zh/guides/jira-status-colors/): Jira 根据状态类别给每个状态三种颜色之一：待办 为灰色，进行中 为蓝色，完成 为绿色。因此 审核中、受阻 和 等待客户 通常都是同一种蓝色。
- [Jira 卡片颜色：按规则为看板卡片着色](https://tintboard.com/zh/guides/jira-card-colors/): 彩色卡片让看板远远一看就清楚：受阻的工作显示红色，缺陷带色条，自己的卡片突出显示。Jira Cloud 有原生选项，但并非所有看板都能用。
- [让色盲同事也能看清的 Jira 看板](https://tintboard.com/zh/guides/jira-color-blind-boards/): 大约每 12 位男性和每 200 位女性中就有 1 位有某种色觉异常。在 Jira 看板上，这往往就是“红色卡片被阻塞了”和“有些卡片颜色稍深”之间的区别。几个习惯就能让颜色对每个人都有效。
- [Jira 免费版：标签、卡片和状态的颜色](https://tintboard.com/zh/guides/jira-free-colors/): Jira 免费版（Free）面向最多 10 人的团队，大多数团队使用团队管理的项目。而这正是 Jira 颜色选项最少的地方：标签颜色由 Jira 决定，状态跟随类别，团队管理的看板没有卡片颜色。
- [如何更改 Confluence Cloud 的字号](https://tintboard.com/zh/guides/confluence-font-size/): Confluence Cloud 没有字号设置：所有读者看到的字号和行距都一样。如果长页面让读者疲劳，或者有读者视力较弱或有阅读障碍，可以考虑以下方法。
